cube3d_time_domain.metric: passive real-pole Foster fit of Y_mixed(s) on 1 Hz..1 GHz; its step response against the exact inverse Laplace transform (Talbot) of Y_mixed(s)/s on 1e-8..1e-1 s
cube3d_time_domain.realisation: passive Foster: real negative poles (dominant from AAA, log-spaced filler), non-negative residues by NNLS; radia.maglev.mixed_galerkin.rom_fit.passive_foster_fit

aaa_direct_diagnostic.what: one-sided AAA fit of Y_mixed on 1 Hz..1 GHz plus DC, stable poles (Re p < 0, |residue| > 1e-3) summed as r/(-p)(1 - exp(p t)), real part
aaa_direct_diagnostic.verdict: not a usable realisation: complex, non-conjugate poles oscillate
